title: Portugal Unlocks €16.3 Billion in EU Recovery Funds as Inflation Ticks Back Up · 01 Sep
keywords: Portugal, EU recovery funds, Recovery and Resilience Facility, inflation, GDP growth, public debt, European Commission, cost of living, fiscal policy, eurozone
notes: Portugal has secured its full allocation of €16.3 billion in European Union recovery grants after meeting 44 reform milestones, offering a significant boost to public investment. Yet the milestone arrives as household budgets face renewed pressure, with annual inflation rising to 3.3 percent in August from 3.0 percent in July, driven largely by fuel costs. The juxtaposition captures a central tension in Portugal's economic story: strong macro-level performance and real reform delivery, but persistent cost-of-living strain for ordinary citizens.
